newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed higher in all months on Monday, reflecting gains in London on Friday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 to 2.1 yen per kg higher, with the benchmark June 1998 contract ending 0.5 yen higher at 186.4 yen per kg. Volume was estimated at 1,155 lots.
Light buying from local investors supported the market from the opening, traders said. The yen's weaker tendency against the dollar also encouraged investors to buy, they said.
Traders said that individual investors are now more interested in trade in platinum and palladium futures which have been more volatile than aluminium.
